"""Record and verify the frozen adjust_bottle instance."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
from rcb_traj import Session


def report(s, label):
    env = s.env
    print(label, json.dumps(s.status()), "bottle", env.bottle.get_pose(),
          "functional", env.bottle.get_functional_point(0),
          "plan_success", env.plan_success, flush=True)


def main():
    output = Path("/app/output")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    s = Session("adjust_bottle", instance="/app/instance.json")
    from envs.utils import ArmTag
    env = s.env
    arm = ArmTag("left" if env.qpose_tag == 0 else "right")
    target = env.left_target_pose if env.qpose_tag == 0 else env.right_target_pose
    print("arm", arm, "model", env.model_id, "target", target, flush=True)
    report(s, "initial")
    s.record_start()
    grasp = env.grasp_actor(env.bottle, arm, pre_grasp_dis=0.10, grasp_dis=0.0)
    print("grasp", grasp, flush=True)
    env.move(grasp)
    report(s, "grasped")
    env.move(env.move_by_displacement(arm, z=0.18))
    report(s, "lifted")
    pose = env.get_place_pose(env.bottle, arm, target,
                              functional_point_id=0, pre_dis=0.0,
                              constrain="free")
    print("upright grasp target", pose, flush=True)
    env.move(env.move_to_pose(arm, pose))
    for _ in range(250):
        s.step()
    report(s, "final")
    actions = s.record_stop()
    if not s.status()["success"]:
        s.save_trajectory(actions, output / "attempt.npz")
        raise RuntimeError("Recorded trajectory did not complete the task")
    replay_status = s.replay(actions)
    print("replay", json.dumps(replay_status), flush=True)
    if not replay_status["success"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Open-loop replay did not complete the task")
    s.save_trajectory(actions, output / "trajectory.npz",
                      meta={"arm": str(arm), "replay_status": replay_status})
    print("Saved", output / "trajectory.npz", "shape", actions.shape, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}
